summary: One church, St. Joseph, High Bridge, with weekday Masses in the on-grounds Madonna & Child Chapel. The Nov 8 and Nov 15 bulletins print the same schedule box (Sat 4 PM; Sun 8 & 11 AM; Tue-Thu 8 AM; Sat confession 3:15-3:45; First Friday 6 PM Adoration), and the website matches. Dated: no daily Mass Nov 17 and 18; Christmas Eve 4 PM Mass. No open questions.

schedule_check.fits_because: The Nov 15 bulletin prints First Friday Adoration at 6pm in the Madonna & Child Chapel; the website gives the same start and chapel and adds the 7pm end and Benediction.

slots.rationale: R1, R11: the standing schedule box of both bulletins prints First Friday Adoration at 6pm in the on-grounds Madonna & Child Chapel (POLICY, Churches and chapels).
